kmeans.noise_handling: Forces all points into nearest centroid (no noise class)

dbscan.noise_handling: Explicit noise class (-1) for low-density spatial outliers

comparative_insights: K-Means enforces spherical clusters and assigns every observation to a regime.
DBSCAN allows arbitrary manifold shapes and explicitly tags peripheral points as noise.
At eps=2.5, DBSCAN isolated 12 points as spatial anomalies.
